description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer dynamic color checkpoint: safe Rust owns global indexed palette mutation, OSC 4/10/11 RGB payload validation, default-color resolution, three-digit indexed colors and DEC color-alias reset semantics.

entries.notes: ColorTableState applies OSC 4 payloads after VT framing, reproduces Microsoft's one- and two-digit xterm rgb component scaling, accepts indexed palette updates and leaves state unchanged for every invalid source payload family.

Indexed TextAttribute values remain symbolic and resolve through one shared ColorTableState, so an OSC 4 update immediately changes the rendered color of already-stored main and alternate-buffer cells without rewriting their attributes.
OSC 4 accepts index 123 and TextColor::Index256 resolves that three-digit entry before and after mutation.
OSC 10 mutates the symbolic default-foreground slot for valid rgb payloads and preserves the previous value for Microsoft's invalid unprefixed syntax.
OSC 11 mutates the symbolic default-background slot for valid rgb payloads and preserves the previous value for Microsoft's invalid unprefixed syntax.
DEC item 1 assigns normal-text foreground/background aliases, item 2 assigns frame aliases, unsupported item 0 is ignored, and RIS restores all initial alias indices.

Already-owned TextAttribute SGR state composes with ColorTableState so individual foreground/background default resets preserve symbolic defaults, legacy-vs-modern attribute identity and the exact yellow/magenta plus indexed-color resolution matrix.
Combined foreground/background default reset returns an indexed-256 background attribute to fully symbolic defaults while retaining current default palette colors.
Reverse-video swaps resolved default colors without destroying symbolic default-background state, and reset restores the original non-reversed attribute with the configured magenta background.
